g.text: REVIEW DRAFT | Labels are electrical connections across all sheets

g.desc: REVIEW DRAFT | Labels are electrical connections across all sheets

g.text: No analog muxes: headphone type is selected once with solder links before installation.

g.desc: No analog muxes: headphone type is selected once with solder links before installation.

g.text: ECO / HD800: bridge each 3-pad selector 1-2; leave all four TURBO INPUT links open; JP9=1-2.

g.desc: ECO / HD800: bridge each 3-pad selector 1-2; leave all four TURBO INPUT links open; JP9=1-2.

g.text: TURBO / planar: bridge each 3-pad selector 2-3; close all four TURBO INPUT links; JP9=2-3.

g.desc: TURBO / planar: bridge each 3-pad selector 2-3; close all four TURBO INPUT links; JP9=2-3.

g.text: Eco may omit U5/U8, U4, Q1/Q2 and amplifier support parts entirely. Turbo populates them.

g.desc: Eco may omit U5/U8, U4, Q1/Q2 and amplifier support parts entirely. Turbo populates them.

g.text: TP1-TP4 are direct driver solder pads. There is no jack and no common audio return.

g.desc: TP1-TP4 are direct driver solder pads. There is no jack and no common audio return.

g.text: L-/R- are driven outputs. OPA1688 current does not establish the original 250mW/18ohm target.

g.desc: L-/R- are driven outputs. OPA1688 current does not establish the original 250mW/18ohm target.

g.text: Configuration links and JP9 must agree before power-up; this design does not hot-switch modes.

g.desc: Configuration links and JP9 must agree before power-up; this design does not hot-switch modes.
